description: Crosswalk an AphiaID from worms_resolve_taxon to one or all nine external identifier systems, or reverse an externalId with required type to a full taxon record. Supply exactly one selector. Forward resultOffset indexes whole identifiers across types in requested order; resume nextResultOffset with unchanged selectors. typeTotals distinguishes successful absence from IDs on another segment; failed types remain separate. IDs stay opaque, including leading zeros and LSIDs. No IDs cannot establish taxon absence; IUCN identifiers are not threat categories.
